0022600156.text: The Clippers (1-3, 12th in the West, 4th in the Pacific) visit the Warriors (2-3, 10th in the West, 2nd in the Pacific) with LA on a three-game losing streak and 0-2 on the road, while Golden State is 0-1 at home and riding a two-game winning streak. The Clippers are missing Bradley Beal (knee inflammation), Brandon Ingram (Achilles surgery), Jordan Miller (shoulder surgery), Max Strus (plantar fasciitis) and Yanic Konan Niederhauser (foot surgery), and the Warriors are without Jimmy Butler III (knee surgery), Kristaps Porzingis (illness) and Moses Moody (knee surgery). The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, and the Clippers won the 2025-26 season series 3-1, including a 115-110 regular-season win in Los Angeles on April 12, 2026.
